title: STABILISING LEARNER TRAJECTORIES: A DOUBLY ROBUST EVALUATION OF AI-GUIDED STUDENT SUPPORT USING ACTIVITY THEORY
reasoning: The paper focuses on a causal impact evaluation of an AI-driven educational support system using statistical methods and Activity Theory. While it contains a standard section on Ethics Approval and mentions ethics within a data governance framework, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary research component.
